caption:
The new Nacon Revolution 5 Unlimited is the first officially licensed PlayStation 5 controller with a built-in screen.

This design allows players to adjust sensitivity and map buttons without pausing the action. Plus, you can mix audio from your phone and console simultaneously. It is a unique approach to peripheral hardware.
